title: Touring Philippine islands and crossing to Japan with Herbie Cowens
summary: They played many islands; after a show's plane vanished at sea, shows went by boat, and Sylvester Lewis impressed him as manager.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: From Lahti(?), where did you go then?

Well, we did a lot of gettin' around in the Philippines. I don't know where. We did so many islands and things, I can't even remember the names of them. We went to Sabu(?), this (?) called Sabu. All of them. I can't even think of the names of them.
You didn't run into Herbie Cowens by any chance, did you?
Oh, I ran into Herbie Cowens in Manila.

Oh, yeah. Well, let me see now. Yeah, I ran into Herbie in Manila. When we were going to Japan... He was on the same boat when we went into Japan, see... Because we had been flying, but one of the planes that one of the shows was using went down in the sea and was never heard of no more, so that the other shows, they got together... That's when Mr. Sylvester Lewis... That's when I started appreciating him. Because all of the managers from all of the big White shows and things, all the shows, they was...
